  states;
- duplicates each checkpoint WKV weight and quantization scale into the

- preserves the existing per-layer KV normalization, RoPE/quantization, cache

- Use the existing masked Triton split-argmax for ROCm EAGLE `topk=1` in both draft-decode and draft-extend.
- Make position advancement optional so the implementation can be reused in draft-extend.
- Add AMD coverage for aligned and misaligned vocabularies, NaN, `-inf`, and all-negat

title: Optimize get_load via shared memory
body_opening:
## Motivation

`/get_loads` currently sends a `GetLoadsReqInput` to the scheduler via ZMQ and waits for the response, adding latency to every load query. 

## Solution

Replace the ZMQ request-response path with a shared-memory region (`/dev/shm`). Each scheduler writes its `LoadSnapshot` to a fixed-size mmap slot; the tokenizer_manager and DP controller read directly without IPC.

- New `LoadSnapshot` flat dataclass + `LoadSnapshotWriter`/`LoadSnapshotReader` using mmap + flock
- Scheduler publishes on every prefill/idle and every N decodes (`--load-snapshot-publish-interval`, default 10)
- DP controller reads shm on dispatch; `DPBudget` skips stale re-reads via timestamp comparis
